subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) When a member is wounded or sick, the others do not abandon it. (b) This kind of behaviour often leads to their ruin. (c) The young remain with their parents for upto 15 years or more. (d) Like some land mammals, whales live in 'herds and in times of danger they look after one another. (e) Though fish and whales live in water, whales do not behave like fish. ক্যাপটেন SSC English Test Papers (f) Many whales show strong family ties. (g) In fact, they behave like human beings. (h) They may cradle it between them or support it on their back so that it can breath.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
